stage: V42: constructive future-live event equivalence, after novelty and theory audit
frozen_before: Any new real-state conditional evaluation or physical replay. NOVELTY.md and STRUCTURE_NOTES.md completed first; opportunities.json only reads paid V41 traces.
fixed: V41 model parameters, original 148 public states, all menus and candidate ordering, 72 roots on six development days, conservative station MCT, SingleMessage history and emission fit, received-message-frozen conditional continuation with fresh own/local observations. No model, policy, candidate, date or loss changes.
candidate: At each observed onboard/platform decision, compare canonical remaining menu, clock and complete visit/offer context, ordered full raw records and basis of every recursively live physical trip. Discard whole dead-trip context only. Per-world suffix table; never use current selected-message equality alone or compare across worlds.
theory_first: Whole-evolution equivalence under fixed independent trip laws and no new archive frames; monotone dependency closure proof and live-trip/raw-message/entry counterexamples. Known context-specific abstraction and coalescent rollout principles, not a predeclared new method.
reference_budget: Exactly 148 x 2 x 4 = 1184 fresh 128-world paired evaluations. Full uses V41 optimized SnapshotExecutor; entry uses V41 strict full-history entry meeting; event_full and event_live use identical event checkpoints and remaining menu with full or projected history. All compare against archived V41 per-world science and their fresh full comparator.
online_budget: Exactly 72 x 4 = 288 fresh controls using strongest V41 shallow base. Preserve all roots and original and new positive/negative cases. Exact-computation candidate must reproduce V41 rollout128 actions, conditional samples and physical trajectories. All quality differences versus cheap therefore remain attributable to the same standard rollout.
sampling: Same original sorted-trip 128-uniform draws, same V38 manifest matching and V41 fallback public-state seed rule. No additional samples, CPU-dependent stopping, outcome filters or saved answers in online control.
cost: One process, one BLAS thread, deterministic rotated arm order. Common archive/manifest resident and separately charged; every control cold init, history update, physical conditioning, generation, compile, event keys, table storage, suffix copying, planning and publication charged. No favorable timing reruns. Compare total costs, never add nested phases twice.
publication: Same V41 ideal event contract and shared action publisher. No wall-clock door-window claim. CPU and wall measured, not added to the physical world clock.
decision: Exact equivalence is required. Net speed benefit does not establish novelty: if the result is only known context abstraction/coalescence, retain its measured engineering status and stop the independent method route. If checks cost more than saved work, stop this implementation. Do not relax live-evidence keys after seeing low hit rates. Do not automatically launch future-message fitting, a different estimator, additional worlds or new-date validation.
limitations: Development evidence only. The construction does not prove minimal state, optimal control, generic correlated-trip validity, arbitrary future publication closure, or a new complexity separation.
